articles.title: Institutional crypto trading platform LMAX is exploring sale, IPO
articles.snippet: LMAX is working with Morgan Stanley and investment bank KBW to assess its options, which could lead to a sale or a public offering.

articles.title: Coinbase's corporate customers can now accept payments from AI agents
articles.snippet: Rolling out this week, Coinbase Business users will be able to accept payments from AI agents, done via the x402 protocol, developed and incubated by the exchange.

articles.title: Internet Freedom Foundation calls India’s BitChat GitHub takedown order ‘unconstitutional’
articles.snippet: The digital rights group says India’s order to remove Jack Dorsey’s BitChat repositories from GitHub exceeds the government’s legal authority and threatens free speech.

articles.title: A quantum roadmap would push Bitcoin much higher: Charles Edwards
articles.snippet: A Bitcoin development roadmap that addresses quantum computing risks could see the price surge by “double digits” very quickly, according to Charles Edwards.

articles.title: Thailand SEC files complaint against Bitkub over alleged false disclosures
articles.snippet: Thailand’s SEC filed a criminal complaint against Bitkub and two former directors over alleged false disclosures linked to a 2021 cyberattack involving $50 million in assets.
